data.title: AlUla Offers Children Educational, Recreational Experiences on World Children's Day
data.content:
AlUla, November 21, 2026, SPA -- AlUla offers children a range of educational and recreational experiences covering agriculture, the environment, archaeology, heritage, and sports. The activities aim to develop their skills and introduce them to the region's history and cultural heritage.
    At the ancient site of Dadan, children take part in guided tours and interactive activities that introduce them to the history of ancient Arabian kingdoms and AlUla's historical significance in northwestern Arabia. Other experiences include agricultural and environmental activities and heritage programs.
    Children can also participate in sports programs that help identify and nurture their talents. AlUla Public Library offers free educational and recreational programs featuring reading and creative activities in a safe environment. These initiatives help children expand their knowledge and connect with AlUla's history, heritage, and future aspirations.
    -- SPA
